description: Combines two voltages with one of six operations, chosen by the buttons; the chosen one is lit

params.text: Sets the operation to addition, a plus b
Sets the operation to subtraction, a minus b
Sets the operation to multiplication, a times b
Sets the operation to division, a divided by b; while b is at 0V the output holds the value it had
Sets the operation to the larger of the two voltages
Sets the operation to the smaller of the two voltages

inputs.text: The first of the two voltages combined; an empty jack counts as 0V
The second of the two voltages combined; an empty jack counts as 0V

outputs.text: The result of the chosen operation
